summary.tldr: Authorizes $4.68 billion in federal spending for the 2022-23 fiscal year.
what_it_does: Authorizes payment of certain public service expenses that were not otherwise provided for in the 2022-23 fiscal year.
Appropriates $4,680,112,624 from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the public service of Canada.
Came into force on royal assent, which was given on 30 March 2023.
summary.background: Bill C-43 was introduced in the House of Commons on 22 March 2023 and received royal assent on 30 March 2023.
